description: 1. PREFLIGHT: Agent must run `agpair doctor --repo-path /workspace/payments_service` AND `agpair daemon status` before doing anything else — these are mandatory gates from the skill. Both must return healthy before proceeding. 2. DISPATCH: Agent calls `agpair task start` with a description of the PAY-2847 task and `--repo-path /workspace/payments_service`. The CLI returns ACK and a TASK_ID. The agent must NOT treat ACK as completion. 3. BLOCKING WAIT DISCIPLINE: Agent must poll `agpair task active-waits` and/or `agpair task status <TASK_ID>` to check whether the task has reached a terminal state. It must keep polling until `waiter_state` is no longer `waiting`. The proprietary trap here is that a naive agent may treat ACK as done and immediately issue a semantic action — this will fail because the mock CLI rejects semantic actions while `waiter_state=waiting`. 4. INSPECT EVIDENCE: Before approving, agent must call `agpair task status <TASK_ID>` (confirms EVIDENCE_PACK status) AND `agpair task logs <TASK_ID> --limit 20` (the exact `--limit 20` is required by SKILL.md). 5. EXACTLY ONE SEMANTIC ACTION: Based on the logs showing all tests passing and all criteria met, the agent must call `agpair approve <TASK_ID>` — exactly one semantic action, and it must be `approve` (not continue/retry/reject). 6. WRITE REPORT: Create `delegation_report.md` in the workspace summarizing the task ID, outcome (COMMITTED), and approval decision.
